simple.meaning: שֶׁלֶג (sheleg) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “snow (probably from its whiteness ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 20 times across Exodus, Numbers, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 6 more, beginning at Exodus 4:6. Its contexts include family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁלֶג (H7950).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שֶׁלֶג (sheleg) / H7950 is traced through Exodus 4:6, Numbers 12:10, 2 Samuel 23:20, 2 Kings 5:27 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.”
The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring‡ or, seed forever.”

Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
Which are black by reason of the ice,
If I wash myself with snow,
Drought and heat consume the snow waters,
For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’
Have you entered the treasuries of the snow,
Hide your face from my sins,
He gives snow like wool,
lightning and hail, snow and clouds;
As the cold of snow in the time of harvest,
Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest,
She is not afraid of the snow for her household;
“Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh:
For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky,
Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field?
Her nobles were purer than snow.

definitions.full: H7950. sheleg שֶׁלֶ֫ג noun masculine Isa 55:10 snow ; — absolute ׳שׁ 1:18 +, שָׁ֑לֶג Exod 4:6 +; construct שֶׁ֫לֶג Jer 18:14 ; — snow , 2Sam 23:20 ( הַשּׁ ׳יוֺם ) = 1Chr 11:22 ; Job 6:16 ; 37:6 (|| מָטָר גֶּשֶׁם ) Psa 147:16 ; 148:8 ( + קִיטוֺר בָּרָד, אֵשׁ, ); שׁ ׳מֵימֵי Job 24:19 , compare 9:30 Qr ( בְּמֵי , < Qr בְּמוֺ De Di Bu and others, snow as purifying; see also [ מַי ]; in poetry שׁ ׳אִצְרוֺת 38:22 (|| ׳א בָּרָד ); symbolic of cold Prov 31:21 ; as moistening, fertilizing Isa 55:10 (|| גֶּשֶׁם ); on mountains, figurative of normal habit, ׳שׁ לְבָנוֺן Jer 18:14 ; simile of whiteness, of leprosy Exod 4:6 (J), Num 12:10 (E), 2Kin 5:27 ; with מִן comp,, of fair skin Lam 4:7 (|| חָלָב ); simile of sins, ׳כַּשּׁ יַלְבִּינוּ Isa 1:18 , compare Psa 51:9 ( מִן compare); simile of refreshment Prov 25:13 (drink cooled by snow, see references in DeToy), of the unfitting ׳כַּשּׁ בַּקַיִץ 26:1 (|| מָטָר ). — On snow in Palestine see Nicol Hast. DB SNOW . תְּלַג noun [masculine] snow ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew שֶׁלֶג ); — absolute ׳ת Dan 7:9 (simile).
